text:
Brock Boeser is three points from 500 for his career, every one of them in a Canucks sweater, as Vancouver Hockey Daily noted this week. He's getting there the hard way. Vancouver has won once in its last ten games, and with Boeser on the ice at five on five the Canucks get only 35% of the expected goals, a sign of how much time his line spends defending. His 15 points lean on the power play (nine of them) and on finishing that runs about two goals ahead of his chances.

That's the honest read: the scoring is real enough, built on a shot that ranks in the league's top tenth for velocity, but some of it is warm luck, and the even-strength results around him are poor. Evolving-Hockey's notes from last season say he played with weaker teammates than almost anyone, which explains part of it. He's averaging nearly 20 minutes over his last ten games, up about two from before, so the milestone should come soon. Watch whether the five-on-five share recovers with it.
headline: Closing in on 500, the hard way
